tech.title: Checkout degraded: 4 timeouts since injection, success 0%

proposes to stop the inventory reconcile job.

detail.rationale: Root blocker pid 90572 (batch_worker/batch_replayable_inventory) has been idle in transaction for 4.0s holding locks that block checkout [DB-1]. Checkout is at 86% success vs 95% SLO with $2,629/min revenue at risk [BIZ-1]. Memory shows terminating this workload previously restored checkout to 100% [MEM-1]. Need registry/tradeoff to confirm replayability and cost before Continuity Guardian can approve.

detail.query: SELECT w.application_name, w.job_name, w.owner_team, w.workload_class, w.replayable, w.replay_cost_minutes, w.typical_runtime_s, w.interrupt_policy, w.business_purpose, e.oncall, e.channel FROM continuity.workload_registry w LEFT JOIN continuity.escalation_contacts e ON e.owner_team = w.owner_team WHERE w.application_name IN ('batch_replayable_inventory')

detail.query: SELECT c.change_id, c.scope, c.policy, c.reason, c.window_start, c.window_end, w.application_name, w.owner_team FROM RP_CHANGE_MGMT.change_calendar c JOIN continuity.workload_registry w ON c.scope_type = 'job' AND c.scope = w.job_name WHERE w.application_name IN ('batch_replayable_inventory') AND current_timestamp() BETWEEN to_timestamp(c.window_start, "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssX") AND to_timestamp(c.window_end, "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssX")

tech.title: Trade-off (computed from DB-1, BIZ-2, BIZ-4): batch_replayable_inventory: expected remaining runtime ~896s, so waiting costs ~$132,298 of checkout revenue at the current loss rate and EXCEEDS the 60s degradation the business tolerates; terminating costs a 4-minute replay of inventory_reconcile (policy may_interrupt).

events.caption: after checking, proposes to stop the inventory reconcile job.

detail.rationale: Root blocker pid 90572 (batch_worker/batch_replayable_inventory) holds locks blocking checkout [DB-1]. Checkout success dropped to 52% vs 95% SLO with $8,859/min revenue at risk [BIZ-4]. The workload is confirmed replayable (job inventory_reconcile, class BATCH_REPLAYABLE, replay cost 4 min, policy may_interrupt) [BIZ-2]. No protected settlements in flight [DB-2] and no active change-calendar window [BIZ-3]. Trade-off analysis shows waiting costs ~$132,298 (896s remaining) and exceeds the 60s degradation tolerance, while terminating costs only a 4-minute replay [BIZ-5]. Memory confirms prior termination restored checkout to 100% [MEM-1].
